test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"They might be repairing the engine now."

options.text: The engine might be repaired now.
The engine may be repairing now.
The engine might be being repaired now.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They might be repairing the engine now."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the engine" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "might be repairing" to "might be being repaired" (present continuous passive).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "now" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The engine might be being repaired now."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The engine might be repaired now." – Incorrect tense (simple passive instead of continuous passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The engine may be repairing now." – Incorrect structure (active voice instead of passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The engine might repaired now." – Grammatically incorrect (missing "be").
